policies.description: When registering a new incident, the opened_by (user submitting) field is mandatory.
When registering a new incident, the caller_id (user affected) field is mandatory.
When registering a new incident, the short_description field is mandatory.
When registering a new incident, the impact field is mandatory.
When registering a new incident, the urgency field is mandatory.
All newly created incidents must have their status set to "new" unless explicitly changed after creation.
references: Default Status: All new Incidents are set to status = new.

policies.policy_name: Incident priority must be derived from impact‑urgency matrix
policies.description: The priority of a newly created incident is automatically calculated from the impact and urgency values according to the predefined Impact × Urgency matrix; any manually supplied priority must match this calculation.
references: Priority Calculation: Priority (critical, high, moderate, low, planning) is determined automatically by the system based on a below pre-defined matrix of Impact x Urgency.

| Impact | Urgency | Priority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| low | low | planning |
| low | medium | low |
| low | high | moderate |
| medium | low | low |
| medium | medium | moderate |
| medium | high | high |
| high | low | moderate |
| high | medium | high |
| high | high | critical |

policies.description: If an assigned_to user is supplied, that user must have users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

policies.policy_name: Assigned user must have Agent or Manager role
policies.description: If an assigned_to user is supplied, that user must hold the Agent or Manager role.
references: Constraints: assigned_to must be an active user with the Agent or Manager role and must be a member of the specified assignment_group.

policies.policy_name: Assigned user must belong to the assignment group
policies.description: If an assigned_to user is supplied, the user must be a member of the provided assignment_group.
references: Constraints: assigned_to must be an active user with the Agent or Manager role and must be a member of the specified assignment_group.

policies.policy_name: All mandatory fields must be validated on creation
policies.description: Any request to create a record must validate that every mandatory field defined for that record type is present and correct.
references: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.
